blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu residents can expect a hot and humid weekend, with scattered rain showers and thunderstorms potentially disrupting outdoor activities as the heat index reaches 38 degrees Celsius on Friday and Saturday, Nov. 27 and 28, according to the state weather bureau. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) Mactan said Metro Cebu and the rest of the province would experience partly cloudy to at times cloudy skies, with possible rain showers or thunderstorms over the two days.
